endpoints.name: Agent Weather API
endpoints.description:

Our index and live reserves; a pool we cannot read is said so. Not advice

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: X1 token compare side by side: Compare 2 to 5 X1 tokens in one call. Pass ?mints= with comma-separated base58 mints. endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: X1 token creator history: Which X1 tokens did this wallet create, and what is left of them? Pass ?creator= (base58). We scan every token our X1 indexer lists and return each one the wallet is recorded as creator of: symbol, mint, creation date if known, liquidity in XNT, holders, 24 h change, LP burned %, and whether liquidity is under 50 XNT. Creator is recorded for only some tokens; the response says how many, so no match is not proof the wallet created nothing.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: X1 agent registry leaderboard: Ranked board of the AI agents registered on the X1 Agent Registry (ERC-8004 for SVM): status up first, then by how many endpoints each lists, ties by registration number. Returns name, asset, owner wallet, status, endpoint count, payable-on-X1 flag, registration time, the registry address and how old our scan is. Optional ?limit= 1-50 (default 20). The registry is young and the list can be short; that is the answer. Our last scan, not a live probe.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: URL status and redirect trace: Is this URL up, and where does it really go? Pass ?url= and get the final HTTP status, the whole redirect chain with each hop's status, response time, content type, size, server and cache headers, and whether it ended on HTTPS. A site that is down or does not resolve is an answer, not an error. Public addresses only.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info

Each answers success, reverted, pending or not found (or mined for pre-2017 Ethereum, which has no status flag), with block, confirmations, gas used, fee in the native coin (Base data fee and blob fees included), from and to, plus counts. A bad item gets its own refusal and does not fail the call. Read from public RPC nodes; not found means th

Returns up to 10 matches per chain with address, symbol, name, price and liquidity: on X1 the depth of its XNT-paired pools (twice the XNT reserve, summed, as our indexer records it); on Solana Jupiter's liquidity in USD with its verified flag. Plus a collisions list when the same symbol appears with different addresses. Anyone can deploy a token with any symbol: the address is the

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: TLS certificate of a host: Read the TLS certificate a public host presents. Pass ?host= (hostname only, optional ?port= 443 or 8443) and get subject, issuer, validity dates, days left, expired or expiring within 14 days, up to 30 SANs, whether the hostname matches, protocol, cipher, RSA or EC key type and size, the chain as Node links it, and whether Node's trust store accepts it. One handshake from our server at one moment. A host that does not resolve or does not complete a handshake is a find

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: Page meta tags and SEO check: Pass ?url= and get the page's SEO basics in one call: title, meta description, canonical, language, robots meta and X-Robots-Tag, Open Graph and Twitter tags, favicon, first 5 h1s, word count, hreflang alternates and JSON-LD schema types. Reads the HTML as served (no JavaScript run), first 1.5 MB. Public http(s) hosts on ports 80/443/8080 only. A page that cannot be reached is an answer, not an error.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: HTTP security headers grader: Pass ?url= and get a graded check of the final response's security headers: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and Set-Cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite; names only, never values). Each header gets present, value, verdict and points; the total is a score out of 100 with the scoring rule in the output. One GET at one moment. Public http(s) hosts on ports 80/443/8080.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: robots.txt checker and parser: Pass ?url= (any page of a site), optional ?agent= (default *, e.g. GPTBot or Googlebot) and ?path=. We fetch the origin's /robots.txt, parse its groups (User-agent, Allow, Disallow, Crawl-delay, Sitemap) and say whether the path is allowed for that agent by the longest-match rule, which rule decided it, and the sitemaps listed. A missing robots.txt (HTTP 4xx) means allowed; a 5xx, 429 or no answer is reported as unknown (allowed: null). Reads the first 600 KB. Publ

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: Page links extractor: Pass ?url= and get the links on a page: up to 200 unique absolute URLs in page order, each with anchor text (80 chars), internal or external, nofollow/sponsored/ugc flags and how often it appears, plus counts of internal, external, nofollow, #fragment and mailto/tel/javascript links. Reads the HTML as served (no JavaScript run), first 1.5 MB. Public http(s) hosts on ports 80/443/8080 only.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: Check for broken links: Check up to 12 links in one call. Pass ?urls= comma separated (a comma inside a URL must be sent as %2C) and get, per URL, the final HTTP status, final URL, redirect count and milliseconds, plus counts of ok, redirected, broken and refused. One GET per URL and redirect hop, 4 URLs at a time, 9 seconds per URL; sites that block bots may answer 401, 403 or 429. A URL that is malformed, private or our own site gets its own refused entry and does not fail the others. More tha

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: Gas prices all chains now: Current gas on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain and Arc in one call, no parameters. For each chain: gas price in gwei, base fee where the chain reports one, latest block and its age, and the estimated cost of a plain 21,000-gas coin transfer in the native coin and in USD (ETH and BNB priced from Chainlink feeds on Ethereum, with the feed's age; Arc pays gas in USDC, taken as 1 USD). Plus the cheapest chain for that transfer. A chain or price we could not read is listed in unr

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: RSS Atom feed latest items: Latest items of a site's RSS or Atom feed. Pass ?url= with a feed address or a normal web page: for a page we look for its advertised feed link (link rel=alternate rss/atom), then return the feed title and up to 15 items with title, link, published time (ISO when parseable) and a summary cut to 160 characters. A page with no feed link, or a URL that is not a feed, is answered with found:false and the reason. Headlines, links and summaries belong to their publishers. P

Only the exact _dmarc.<domain> name is read. DKIM selectors cannot be enumerated, so DKIM is not graded. DNS

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: DNS records for a domain: The main DNS records of a domain in one call. Pass ?domain= and get A and AAAA (with TTL), MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA and SOA, at most 20 records per type and 300 characters per record, each type with its own status (ok, none, nxdomain, timeout, servfail and similar). A name that does not exist (NXDOMAIN) is an answer, not an error. Read from our resolver at one moment; IP addresses and .local/.internal names are refused.

Found by searching live RPC reads (28 at most), so the answer comes from the chain, not an index. A time before the chain's first block is a finding. A time with no zone is read as UTC.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info

endpoints.description: ERC20 token balance of a wallet: ERC20 token balance of any wallet on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: pass ?address=&token=&chain= and get the raw balance, the decimals, the symbol and the balance in token units, with the block it was read at. ETH priced from the Uniswap v3 WETH/USDC pool. Paid in USDC on Base.

Agents have their own board at /arc/bloodstream/ and a scored record readable at /api/x402/bloodstream-agent. No stake, no payout: the reward is a verifiable record.

The truth is read one hour after launch. Pair with /api/x402/bloodstream-call.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: Agent rug-hunting track record: The scored Bloodstream record of one agent wallet (the wallet that paid for its calls): tier (Cell / Hunter / Antibody / Apex), points (right calls that disagreed with our scanner, proven by the chain one hour later), points today, scored calls, right calls, current and best streak, calls still waiting for the truth, and the next tier. A verifiable track record for agents that hunt rugs.

endpoints.description: Extract text from a PDF: The text of a public PDF, page by page: pass ?url= of a whitepaper, filing, invoice or paper and get every page's text with page markers, the page count and the file size. endpoints.description: Phishing domain check: Is this link safe to send a user to? Pass ?domain= (or a URL). From public records: when it was registered and by which registrar (RDAP, the registry's own record), its DNS, who issued its TLS certificate and until when, and whether the name imitates one of 40 brands phishing kits copy (coinbase, metamask, uniswap...). A record we could not read is reported as unread, never as clean. Paid in USDC on Base.

endpoints.description: x402 endpoint checker & doctor: Why will Coinbase not list your x402 endpoint, and can a standard client pay it? Pass ?url= (and &method=POST for a POST route). We read its 402 as a client does, check what Coinbase's facilitator and Bazaar enforce (accepts[0] network, the $0.001 minimum, descriptions over 500 characters, a bazaar schema that must describe info, query numbers typed as strings, routeTemplate, exposed headers), and ask Coinbase's own validator. Each problem comes with its fix.

endpoints.description: Bazaar listing rank check: Where does your x402 endpoint come up when an agent searches Coinbase's Bazaar? Pass ?url= and optionally &query= (up to 3; left out, your own tags are searched). For each search: your rank in the top 20, the sellers above you with their price, tags and 30-day payers, the median price, and the concrete fixes (serviceName, tags, the words your description opens with). endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a TWAP cancellation for L1 signing. Supply action type twapCancel, asset ID a, and TWAP ID t. Sign and submit unchanged using the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 for an unknown, cancelled or filled TWAP, or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a pUSD withdrawal batch to the bridge routing address. `recipientAddr` defaults to the signer and is echoed in `plan.plan.details.recipient`; check it before signing. 422 when the asset is not on the bridge's list or the amount is under its minimum (2 pUSD for USDC on Base), since the bridge never delivers smaller transfers. On submit, `final` means the pUSD reached the bridge; delivery to the destination chain takes minutes.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Deploy the deposit wallet, then add its missing trading approvals, one step per call. Requires the signer's `credentialToken` (401 once revoked). Undeployed: `plan.plan.details.step` is "deploy"; the wallet signs and POSTs the action to /predict/polymarket/wallet/batch/submit, then calls again (202 while pending). Deployed: a Batch of the missing approvals for the same route. 422 "Nothing to onboard" is not charged; GET /predict/polymarket/wallet/{signer} checks for free.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a batch redeeming resolved positions to pUSD; `conditionId` narrows it to one condition. `plan.plan.details.conditions` lists what this batch redeems. Protocol V2 positions go in a batch of their own: when CTF positions are redeemable too, this batch carries those and `plan.plan.details.pendingConditions` lists the V2 conditions for the next prepare. V2 outcomes that pay nothing are skipped. 422 when nothing is redeemable.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Trade and settlement history of a venue account, newest first and cursor-paged: fills (TRADE, with the pUSD that actually moved, fees included), REDEEM, SPLIT/MERGE, CONVERSION and rewards, each with its Polygon transaction hash. Deposits and withdrawals appear only when `type` names them. To page, pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same filters. The ground truth after an ambiguous submit. Errors: 400 invalid filter, 422 cursor or filters refused by the venue, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a batch moving native USDC held by the deposit wallet to the bridge (credited as pUSD). Only for USDC already in the deposit wallet: the normal path is sending USDC to the bridge deposit addresses from GET /predict/polymarket/wallet/{signer}, which needs no batch. The chainhilt wallet signs `response.actions[0]`, a Batch, and POSTs it to /predict/polymarket/wallet/batch/submit. Errors: 400 invalid input, 422 balance or bridge minimum (not charged), 429 daily relayer cap.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Construct a prediction-market order; never submits. Needs a `credentialToken` from /predict/polymarket/credentials. Returns `construction` and a signature action the chainhilt wallet signs and POSTs to /predict/polymarket/orders/submit. Review orderSummary and warnings before signing: `estimatedBuilderFee` (ours) and `estimatedVenueFee` (Polymarket's) are pUSD on top of the principal. Errors: 400 invalid input, 401 invalid credentialToken, 422 order refused, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Deterministic prediction-market quote from the live order book: integer micro-unit book walk (buys round principal up, sells round proceeds down). `estimatedVenueFee` is Polymarket's own taker fee at the average price (shares × rate × p × (1 − p), from the market's live fee schedule; null when the venue reports a fee type this API cannot price). Informational only — nothing is reserved. Errors: 400 invalid input, 422 untradable market, wrong token or thin book, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prediction market detail: resolution rules, outcomes with their tokenIds, tick size, fees and the raw venue payload. Errors: 400 invalid id, 422 unknown market, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview the Hyperliquid cancel-all action the user must sign; it cancels the account's open orders on the default perp DEX and spot, but not on builder-deployed perp DEXs. Errors: 400 invalid input or no open orders, 502 provider failure; execution may return 422 exchange rejection. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Held outcome-token positions with PnL and redeemability. Live positions from the venue's public data feed: size, average/current price, cash and realized PnL, and whether each position is redeemable (market resolved). Redemption itself is an on-chain action from the holding wallet; resolved positions redeem to pUSD. `truncated: true` means the upstream page cap was hit and more positions exist. Errors: 400 invalid address or filter, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Live order book for each outcome of a prediction market: bids and asks (price, size) per outcome tokenId, read from the venue at `observedAt`. Check depth and spread here before quoting or constructing an order. A closed or untradable market returns 422, which is not charged.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Search prediction markets. `closingAfter`/`closingBefore` bound the venue query; other filters apply after fetching `limit` rows, so a page can be short or empty while `nextCursor` is set: keep paging until it is absent. `sort=closingTime` lists open markets closing soonest; with `closingBefore` it finds short-horizon markets such as the 5-minute crypto up/down slots, which text `query` search never returns. Errors: 400 invalid query or cursor, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: An event and every market under it. The venue's grouping of markets: every line of a match, or the mutually exclusive outcomes of a multi-outcome question (`negRisk: true` means exactly one of them resolves Yes). Markets come back in the search-result shape (outcome tokenIds, tradability, fees), each with the venue's short `label` when it has one. Reach an event from any market's `eventId`; an unknown id is a 422.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Select the best available swap quote and return ordered unsigned transaction actions. Run the returned actions in order: up to two approvals, then the swap. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 when no connector quotes or the swap cannot be built.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare an order for L1 signing with the configured lowercase builder and fee in tenths of a basis point. Sign and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input, 409 builder approval slots full, 428 builder fee not yet approved (sign the returned approval, then retry), 502 provider failure, 503 builder not configured. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a USDC-only withdrawal to the signing account; other assets return 400. Unified account and portfolio margin accounts must use spot; manual mode may use spot or perp. Arbitrum receives the amount less a fee, and gas comes from the balance left, so the whole balance cannot be withdrawn. Sign the typedData and submit it unchanged to submitPath. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Return the Hyperliquid noop action the user must sign to mark a nonce as used for safer in-flight cancellation workflows. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview the Hyperliquid cancel action the user must sign for an open numeric order ID. Errors: 400 invalid input or no matching open order, 502 provider failure; execution may return 422 exchange rejection. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a user-signed abstraction change: disabled, unifiedAccount, or portfolioMargin. Sign with the owner's wallet and submit to the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a single-order modification by OID or CLOID for L1 signing. Supply the full replacement order. Omit action.a unless true. Sign and submit unchanged using the returned submitPath. See /skills.md for signing rules. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a TWAP order for L1 signing. Estimated total value at the current mid must be at least $100 for perps or 100 of the pair's quote token for spot; builder-deployed perps are not supported. Sign and submit using the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input, unknown asset or value under the minimum, 502 provider failure; execution may return 422 exchange rejection. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Produce an agent-ready Hyperliquid portfolio report covering equity, PnL, leverage, margin health, liquidation exposure, and concentration. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Return chart-ready Hyperliquid portfolio graph data for account value, PnL, drawdown, deposits, and withdrawals. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Detect high leverage, liquidation proximity, concentration, funding drag, and missing stops for a Hyperliquid account. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview a Hyperliquid trade with notional, margin impact, slippage, liquidation estimate, exchange fees, and builder fee. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a user-signed sendAsset transfer between users, subaccounts, spot and perp DEXs. Use "" for the default perp DEX and "spot" for spot; perp transfers require the collateral token. Sign with the main wallet and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath (unpaid). Invalid input returns 400; execution may return 422 for rejection or 502 for provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Audit Hyperliquid open orders for stale, duplicate, conflicting, reduce-only, or unprotected orders. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Compare bridge routes, best first: tokens, estimated and minimum target amounts, fees by token, duration, expiry and the approval each route needs. sourceAmount is exactly what leaves the wallet. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 when no adapter returns a route.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare the selected bridge route as ordered unsigned transactions: an exact-amount ERC-20 approval when needed (after an approval to 0 for tokens like Ethereum USDT), then the bridge transaction. Pass the minTargetAmount and maxNativeFee the user accepted; if the fresh quote delivers less or charges more native fee, it returns 409 with quote { adapter, estimatedTargetAmount, minTargetAmount, nativeFee } and no actions. Send the actions before expiresAt.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Look up a bridge after its transaction was sent, by the adapter that built it and the hash of the bridge transaction on the source chain; layerzero and relay also need the providerRef that bridge/execute returned (0x and 64 hex characters). Poll it every 10 to 15 seconds until the status is filled, refunded or failed; an error answer, such as a 429, is not charged. After a 429, wait the Retry-After seconds.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Resolve an order asset ID from asset (symbol, spot pair, @index, or numeric market index) and sourceDex ("" for default perps, "spot" for spot). Spot IDs are 10000 + spot market index; already formatted IDs are preserved. Token indexes are not market indexes. Unknown or ambiguous assets return 400; provider failures return 502. Use assetId as orders[].a or modify order.a before signing. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Add or remove isolated margin for a perp asset. ntli is a signed integer in millionths of USD: 1000000 adds 1 USD; -1000000 removes 1 USD. isBuy defaults to true. Sign and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath (unpaid). Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Set cross or isolated leverage for a perp asset. Supply isCross and positive integer leverage; market limits apply. Sign the L1 preview and submit it unchanged to the returned submitPath (unpaid). Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Fidelity
endpoints.description: Seller fidelity badge (2 USDC / 30 days)

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Fidelity
endpoints.description: Visible-token bill check (0.01 USDC; 5/day free)

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Fidelity
endpoints.description: Audit seller vs Workers AI reference (0.05 USDC; 2/day free)

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Show remaining calls/expiry of your MoneyTools Settle key.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Read a delivery receipt and its history.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Move a receipt paid -> delivered | failed | refunded (refundTx optional).

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Create a delivery receipt (status paid) for an order/request ref; idempotent per ref.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Mark a claimed authorization settled or failed (failed allows a retry).

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Idempotency gate: claim an EIP-3009 authorization (payer+nonce) before settling. claimed:false means duplicate — do not settle again.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Status of a settlement watch.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Watch a timed-out/unknown x402 settlement: re-checked on-chain for up to 24h; POSTs your webhook when it becomes settled/failed/expired.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Record an x402 payment the agent made (or update a reserved one by spendId/ref): status settled|failed|pending|refunded, tx; verify:true checks a Base tx on-chain (read-only). Builds the spend log / receipts.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Verify an x402 settlement on Base USDC right now (by tx hash, or payer+nonce / paymentPayload via USDC.authorizationState). Returns settled|failed|pending|not_settled|expired|unknown.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Spend log / receipts for a payer address: totals (settled, pending, refunded), top sellers and the latest receipts over the last N days (1-31).

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Pre-payment check before signing an x402 payment: 'would this payment exceed my cap?'. Pass the 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED (header or body) or amountUsd, plus payer and optional sessionId/host. Returns allow|deny with reasons and remaining budget; reserve:true also logs it as pending.

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle
endpoints.description: Read the spend caps of a payer address plus what it spent in the last 24h (and in a session).

endpoints.name: MoneyTools Settle

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you test an x402 or MPP client, wallet, SDK, facilitator or CI: a test target for x402/MPP clients, use it in your integration tests. GET or POST, every rail we support (Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Celo, Avalanche, Optimism, Ethereum, Solana, Stacks, MPP); returns an echo of your request and a test receipt (rail, network, asset, amount, tx). Free rail list: ?dry=1. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when an agent needs recent headlines with links and dates: crypto and AI news (GDELT index; 11 topics or your own q=), US agency press releases (SEC, FTC, DOJ, Federal Reserve) or Federal Register rules. Up to 50 per call, newest first, last 1-168 hours; list age stated, sources cited. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when an agent needs to see what it has stored: lists up to 100 keys (optionally under prefix) in the namespace of the paying wallet with size, stored_at and expires_at, plus a cursor for the next page. Keys only, no values: read one with /kv/get. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when an agent needs a value it stored earlier with /kv/put: returns the text (and parsed json when it was stored as JSON), size, stored_at and expires_at for key in the namespace of the paying wallet; a missing or expired key is refused (404) before an x402 payment is taken. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when an agent needs memory between runs without an account: store value (text or JSON, up to 8 KB) under key in a private namespace keyed to the wallet that pays, with ttl 60 s to 90 days (default 30). Read it back with /kv/get and /kv/list from the same wallet. Write happens after payment settles. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need base64 in or out: encode UTF-8 text to base64 (standard or url_safe) or decode base64 back to text (hex when the bytes are not UTF-8), up to 64 KB, no external call. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you must check that a JSON document fits a schema before acting on it: validates json against a JSON Schema subset (type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, min/max, length, pattern, format, anyOf/oneOf/allOf/not) and returns every violation with its path; unsupported keywords are listed, never silently passed. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need to inspect a JWT without a key: decoded header and payload, alg, kid, iat/nbf/exp as ISO times and whether it is expired now. Decode only: the signature is never verified and verified is always false. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when an agent needs to know how it is seen from outside: its public IP plus the country, region, city, ASN, AS organization, Cloudflare colo and TLS/HTTP version recorded by Cloudflare's edge for this connection. No external lookup. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a checksum or digest of a string: sha256 (default), sha1, sha384, sha512 and md5 of text given as utf8, hex or base64 (up to 64 KB), hex digests, no external call. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need fresh UUIDs: n (1-100) cryptographically random v4 or time-sortable v7 identifiers, no external call. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need an account's transaction count on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: nonce at the latest block and the pending nonce (queued transactions in the node's pool), with block and as_of. Useful before signing or to spot activity. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need ENS on Ethereum: name to address (name=vitalik.eth, via the Universal Resolver, with resolver address) or address to primary name (address=0x..., reverse record, forward-verified). A name or address with no record answers found=false. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you must know whether an address is a contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: is_contract, bytecode size, sha256 of the bytecode, the EIP-1967 implementation if it is an upgradeable proxy, and the EIP-7702 delegate if it is a delegated plain account, read from a public node. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need to know whether a transaction succeeded on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: receipt status, block, confirmations, gas used, effective gas price, created contract and up to 50 logs (address, topics, data). No receipt yet: refused before any charge. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index

endpoints.description: AI image generation, DRAFT quality (faster, lower fidelity) on the all-ages surface: the cheap tier for agent loops iterating on a prompt. endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Speech-to-text transcription (faster-whisper): POST audio (up to 10 minutes) and get a text transcript with the detected language. Send the audio as a JSON body {"audio":"<base64>","filename":"..."} — a raw audio body or a multipart file part also works. Returns {text, language, language_probability, duration_s, model}.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: x402 Knock Cohort: the all-time unique knocking-IP registry — who has actually knocked this shop, per route and in total, plus a deterministic sample. All-time by design (a knock registry that forgets yesterday understates the market). From the shop's own signed records. Call bare.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: x402 Health Score (30-day): a derived 0-100 shop-wide conversion score plus per-route status (healthy/degraded/cold) — the endpoint audit a buyer runs before paying an x402 seller. A route is healthy at >=25% conversion with >=5 knocks, degraded below with a sufficient sample, cold with no sample. From the shop's own signed records. Call bare for the trailing 30 days.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: AI image generation, all-ages surface. No adult content. Not generated: identifiable real people, copyrighted characters or brands, named living artists, religious/national symbols, demeaning protected-class depictions. Some images are not legal to generate and are refused before rendering. POST {"prompt":"...","aspect":"1:1","seed":42}. Returns a job id; poll the free GET /v1/media/images?job=<id> to state=done, then download result_url. ~25-40s.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: x402 Demand Pulse: the shop's live x402 demand over a recent window — how many agents knocked, how many payment attempts turned into settlements, and which routes are drawing traffic right now, from the shop's signed records. Call with ?hours=<1-168> for a custom window, or bare for the trailing 24h.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Signal Loop: one call for the whole live picture — the shop's own x402 demand pulse (trailing 24h), the 30-day per-route payment gap, the live x402 ecosystem demand report, and the current Base gas/ETH quote — each section is the individual data SKU's own payload, so the bundle never disagrees with the parts. The one route a repeat buyer polls on a schedule. Call bare.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Proposal Register: the shop's agents' original business ideas, as a durable, dedup-able register — every earn/defend/improve/attack proposal, with its action, evidence, price, and how many times it was re-proposed. The raw material the shop turns into live SKUs, queryable by any buyer. Call with ?limit=<1-100> for a custom count, or bare for the 25 newest distinct ideas.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: SKU Manifest: the shop's live SKU catalog — every executed proposal (a live same-shape SKU or a gated novel one), with its route, price, and shape status. The shape-budget record of what the shop's executor has turned into real, purchasable SKUs. Call bare for the 25 newest.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: x402 Funnel (30-day daily): the shop's whole-shop knock->attempt->settlement time series per UTC day — the trend of x402 demand on this shop and where it drops off, oldest first. Zero-traffic days omitted. From the shop's own signed records. Call bare for the trailing 30 days.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Route Heat (30-day): per-route x402 payment-gap data — how many agents knocked each route, how many payment attempts turned into settlements, the settlement gap, and the route's own list price. The 30-day window complement to the live demand pulse, listable as a same-shape data SKU.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Plainsight's x402 market intelligence (flagship): what x402 agents actually PAY for, measured from the Bazaar's own 30-day usage — ranked by distinct buyers (not looping volume), the price split that clears (sub-$0.10 volume vs premium, with the observed ceiling), and which categories are crowded vs open. For builders and operators deciding what to list and at what price. Read from the facilitator's own usage counters.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions (GET): a bare call runs the default one-turn completion in the OpenAI envelope; answered in <= 512 tokens. The same model and price as POST.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: x402 Route Heat: per-route payment-gap snapshot from the shop's signed records — who knocks on each paid route (unique agents), attempts vs settlements over 30 days, and the gap between them. Where x402 agents actually pay, route by route.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Quick brief: a short 2-3 sentence research answer on any topic — the cheap first call of the full research brief.

endpoints.name: Plainsight

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Generated research brief: findings with numbers, operator implications, one open question.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Uncensored one-turn chat (abliterated LLM): direct, specific answers to any prompt.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Route oracle: which x402 seller to route a task to, ranked by real 30-day usage. Call with ?task=<term> (e.g. ?task=price); a bare call routes the gas lane.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Geolocate an IP: city, region, country, ASN/org, and timezone, from a cached keyless public geolocation feed (no LLM, no GPU). Call with ?ip=<ip>, or bare to geolocate your own IP. The shop's cheapest data SKU.

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: Speech-to-text transcription (faster-whisper): POST audio (up to 10 minutes) and get a text transcript with the detected language. endpoints.name: Plainsight

Call with ?q=<query> to search a custom topic, or bare for the documented default (x402 payment protocol). The shop's highest-volume lane, priced at the per-query web-search floor.

endpoints.name: Plainsight

Each filled field names its source. POST JSON {"domain":"coinbase.com"} or {"url":"https://www.coinbase.com"}. Nothing found is HTTP 200 with nulls, not an error. $0.03 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Extract schema.org structured data from a public HTML page: JSON-LD (@graph flattened), top-level microdata, and Open Graph / Twitter meta. Normalizes Product/Offer, Article, Organization, Event, FAQ, and breadcrumbs. POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com"}. No structured data is HTTP 200 with empty arrays, not an error. Public http(s) only. $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Fingerprint a public page so agents can detect changes: final url, etag, lastModified, sha256 contentHash of normalized visible text, raw byteLength, and fetchedAt. endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether a specific package version has known vulnerabilities, across npm and PyPI, using the Open Source Vulnerabilities database. endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE in the US National Vulnerability Database: description, CVSS score and severity, affected weakness (CWE) identifiers and reference links. Use it to check whether a vulnerability a scanner reported is real and how severe it is, before deciding what to patch first.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Static code review of a source snippet: security problems, bugs and code smells, each with a severity and a message, plus an overall quality score. Use it to review code before merging, to find hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, or to get a second opinion on a diff. Accepts source code in any language.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain against two independent resolvers (Cloudflare and Google) and report whether their answers agree. Use it for DNS lookup, MX record checks, SPF/DKIM TXT inspection, nameserver discovery, or to debug propagation and mail routing.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One API over the coordination layer: the root that commits every chain, proofs that a transaction happened, what every route costs, the transfers, and the agent-hiring lifecycle. Most operations are public reads. Writes say who may make them in `security` (RelayerKey = X-API-Key, OperatorToken = x-operator-token) and in x-taifoon-auth.rule; nothing here signs or sends a transaction for you. A 2xx JSON object answered to a caller that sent no key also carries `get_key` (and the headers x-taifoon-get-key and Link rel=free-key): how to get a free key in one call; proofs, evidence packs, cards and this document are left as written. Lineage language: a sale walks offer in → classify → listed → hired → delivered → graded → settled → legs written → accrued → split → PAID → recorded; a venue adapter has offer.in · offer.out · job.in · job.out; the seller of record pays on by forward · share · period · markup; a leg is Owed → Reserved → Sent | Held | Refunded; a hop reads OK · HELD · MISSING · BROKEN. On the wire the hop ids are the event field step and the metric label stage; a wire name is never renamed.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Enlist an expert of the tenant's product: { expert key:<24hex>, payee (an address, or the expert's key ref until it claims one), chains, share_bps ≤ 7000, cap per period, classes } → a nomination sma.nomination.v1 in state proposed; the expert POSTs { id, accept: true } to accept; the admin POSTs { id, revoke: true } to revoke.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Close the loop on a case: answer it (words, by an expert, an agent or a member), grade it (Jev, the buyer or the admin), or tune a loop of the tenant inside its bounds (admin only). A graded answer becomes a fix node and a fixed_by edge; the provider leg goes to the answerer's nominated payee; the meter line is written.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The product's knowledge graph as the helpdesk holds it (?product=<id>, ?scope=public|product|tenant, ?weakest=1 for the ranked unknowns): nodes { id, kind, scope, label, confidence, asked, learned_from }, edges { from, to, kind, weight }, open { category, license, weights, source }.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Show Me Around ++ the helpdesk (_SMA_HELPDESK_v1_, lang/cue/sma-helpdesk.cue): one question about one product → a case. The product's graph answers first (free, measured); an unknown is routed to a nominated expert, the tenant's agent or a person; every answer is graded before it is settled as one sma.case line (0.10 USDC above the free allowance of 20 a day per key; legs provider 70 · graders 20 · ecosystem 10); the trail is sealed under the tenant's topic helpdesk.<name>, read by nobody but th

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Chain Desk's state per chain in the Prometheus text format (_DESK_METRICS_v1_), to scrape into an exchange's own monitoring; ?format=json for JSON.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Completeness proof over final blocks (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): every ERC-20 transfer to (in) or from (out) an address in a range, and a proof there is no other; NONE proves absence.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: State proof of an account at a final block (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): its nonce and native balance, and one ERC-20 balance by its slot; an address with no account is proven absent.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The deposit lambda registry: the built-in lambdas (evm, tron, substrate) and the third-party manifests (data only), each with its family, chains, finality, hash and whether a reader exists.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Membership proof of one EVM transaction (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): it is in a final block under the superroot, who signed it, and exactly which ERC-20 transfers it moved; the bundle verifies offline.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The desk_deposits lane of /v1/stream on its own connection (the same events, named as before). Server-sent events of the deposits to watched addresses: each transfer once per level it reaches (seen, confirmed, final), resumable by Last-Event-ID.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The desk_finality lane of /v1/stream on its own connection (the same events, named as before). Server-sent events of the desk chains' finality: finalized each time a chain's final block moves, halt and resume from its health (fail closed); every event id is the resume cursor.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Chain Desk's chains (_DESK_API_v1_): every chain the desk serves with its family (evm, tron, substrate), CAIP-2 id, finality rule, sources and health, and what a desk should do now.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record a batch-judge outcome for the coordination layer (relayer key required).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.description: The evidence Jev reads about one job the observatory keys — an ERC-8183 / memo-ACP job, an extra deployment’s job, or an assurance-hook job by its 32-byte id (the layer’s hook or Moonbeam ACP’s): task, price, parties, the timeline with the deadline, how it ended, the seller’s record and this buyer’s history with this seller, plus what is not known.

endpoints.description: One A2A Registry agent as a hirer needs it: its own record, whether it is open, its dialect, a live card probe, the classes it works, ERC-8004 cross-links.

endpoints.description: The evidence pack for one Olas Mech marketplace request on Base — the public prompt, tool, mech, fee and response.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.description: HashProof, an ERC-8004 agent on Celo, for discovery: the ERC-8004 agents that publish its MCP endpoint, and credentials in its CredentialRegistry on Celo, read on chain in one batch (_CELO_8004_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.description: Demands, newest first, each with every step the auto-match loop wrote on it (_DEMAND_INTAKE_v1_).

endpoints.description: How much went through the coordination layer on one day, in one read: calls per route and key class, handshakes by protocol, gateway λ steps by kind, hires settled, grades, bridges (n, volume, fee), the evaluator fee, grade purchases, agents onboarded, resources listed and unique callers — per chain, split Taifoon’s own (its keys, its servers, wallets in the address registry, devnet test keys) vs customers, each labelled on-chain or off-chain (_COORD_METRICS_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The gateway counters, the feed /v1/metrics reads for calls through the gateway: in total, per resource, per JSON-RPC method, per ending state and per day (off-chain).

endpoints.description: One recorded gateway call (taifoon.step.v1): the λ path, the digests of the request and the answer, and the step digest recomputed.

endpoints.description: The resources the drop-in gateways serve: point a stock MCP client at the resource’s gateway URL instead of its own endpoint, and every call is forwarded unchanged, recorded as a λ step and counted (_LAMBDA_GW_MCP_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One MCP registry server as a hirer needs it: its own record, the open endpoint, a live probe, the classes it works, ERC-8004 cross-links.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The official MCP registry for discovery: servers with the endpoint they published, whether it is free to call, a live probe, and ERC-8004 cross-links (_MCP_REGISTRY_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The x402 Bazaar for discovery: resources paid through the CDP facilitator, each a payable row with its prices and readiness; nothing is paid (_X402_BAZAAR_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The resale wall of one class: an admitted outside seller answers your input, code checks the answer before you are charged, Jev grades it after, and the seller is paid from your payment (_RESALE_WALL_v1_). inference.metered (and the venue classes chat.converse, text.generate, reason.general) is served by the Taifoon GPU instead (_GPU_X402_WALL_v1_): an OpenAI chat completion { messages, max_tokens } for 0.001 USDC per request of up to 5,000 tokens, served by taifoon.gpu.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One Fetch.ai agent as a hirer needs it: its own Almanac record and the request models its protocols declare.

endpoints.description: Fetch.ai Agentverse agents from its own public search: address, hosting type, protocols, interactions (_AGENTVERSE_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Olas Mech marketplace on every chain it runs on (Gnosis, Base, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Robinhood Chain) in one read: every mech with its chain, how it is paid, its card with each tool’s input/output schema, which tools actually answer, and its ERC-8004 agent id.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Virtuals sellers on chain and in Virtuals’ own agent registries, joined by wallet: the memo-ACP sellers on Base and the ACP v3 sellers on Base, Arc and Robinhood, each with its ERC-8004 agent id, ACP v2 agent id, offerings and metrics, and how a buyer outside Virtuals hires one with Taifoon as the evaluator.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every coordination mech request, newest first, folded from its events on chain.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The task document and the unsigned approve + request calls for a coordination mech request. Nothing signs here.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The coordination layer as a mech: post a request on chain (a grade, a V5 proof, an agent readiness or match), the layer’s worker delivers the result hash + URI on chain.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Calls, payers and revenue of the two paid trading routes (market/candles, trading/record), outside vs Taifoon’s own by the paying wallet.

Generated in coord (lang/gen/market-book.json) and vendored.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record a Grid hire and, when both sides have wallets, plan its settlement on the assurance hook.

endpoints.description: Where the Grid is short: chains and kinds ranked by demand, with the bootstrap budget and the settlement rule.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every provider on the Grid, their resources and measured GRID.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: My GRID: a wallet’s measured ledger, what was settled on Taifoon mainnet, what is pending, and its balance.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Resource pools: several operators’ resources working as one, with the pool’s fee (at most 30%, locked at join).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: What the Grid earns: the live rate per kind, and the attribution of revenue to every node behind Taifoon (the one provider at every outlet).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The work coord placed on a node: outlet jobs and Taifoon buyers' work arrive here, never through the contributor's own outlet accounts.

endpoints.description: A taifoon-node's signed heartbeat, every 5 minutes: what the box offers now (capacity per kind), its payout election, and the usage receipts of the work it ran.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Bring a resource to the Grid in one request: the oracle probes it every hour and pays GRID for measured work.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The jobs a grader is needed for: paid and delivered with no ruling, paid and delivered then rejected, funded and past the deadline with no ending — ranked by what is at stake, each with how complete its evidence is.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Many jobs’ ERC-8183 trails in one call, prepared: a finished job’s trail is read once and kept.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every place this layer uses TypeSafe’s Jev, driven through the API and landed on the devnet as its own transaction.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: score(job): grade any job of the lambda catalogue under RUBRIC_v2 — an agent job on an ERC-8183 venue reads its evidence pack; a cross-chain order or a stream-service order step is graded on its observed stages and their proof under the superroot.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Ask for your own Jev seat, or drop it: { action: create | revoke }. The seat is certified within a minute; its key never leaves the Jev unit’s memory.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Taifoon as the evaluator of a job: the JudgeAdapter a buyer names as evaluator and the V4 hook per network (Base, Arbitrum One, Arc, Robinhood Chain, Monad, the devnet), the fee rule the hook escrows, the rubric hash, and the two-line recipe for a seller and for a buyer.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The layer’s own contract actions on the devnet — hook funds/submits/completes, verdicts, x402 captures, stamps, judge decisions, ERC-8004 feedback — read as genome lines, each a log with its transaction.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every live Taifoon contract on every chain, read into genome observations: V4 hooks, fee-forwarding adapters, pools, assurance markets and outcome sources, the Jev arbiter and logs, the V5 verifier set, CCTP routers, the ICP light client (all from the address registry), the Solana devnet programs and the x402 settlements the settle watcher proved.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One recorded Jev answer: the canonical body, its recomputed digest, and the JevAnswered transaction.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record Jev answers the layer did not fetch (an n8n TypeSafe node, the registry, a runner): stored, digested and, when `record` names a network, anchored on its JevAnswerLog.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every answer Jev gave this layer — each question, value, the full distribution, model, latency and the credential that paid — recorded as a jev.answer.v1 body with its digest on the devnet JevAnswerLog.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Put an already-recorded judge decision and its answer record on one more network: { network } is the name or chain id of a live network, or a list (GET /v1/judge/record/networks). Charged once per decision and network: a network already paid for, queued or recorded is queued again at no charge.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Alias of POST /v1/judge/decisions/:id/record with network "base": put an already-recorded judge decision and its answer record on Base (JevDecisionLog + JevAnswerLog, chain 8453), signed by the recorder 0xe9F0E71e7Fc66864126C0aE5588a7858b25dE51D, the only address JevAnswerLog trusts on Base.

endpoints.description: One recorded judge decision with its anchors resolved and the calldata a reader recomputes.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Where a Jev grade may be recorded on chain, and what a record costs there now: one row per network with its chain id, the two logs (JevAnswerLog, JevDecisionLog), whether it is live, and the price of one recorded grade in USDC and in bought grades. The Taifoon devnet is the only free one.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every decision the judge made for this layer — pad picks, skill rankings, assembles, grades, study batteries — each with a recomputable digest and its transaction on the devnet JevDecisionLog.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Venice's name for the System One API (POST /api/v1/decisions there): the same handler as POST /v1/systemone, so a client written for either host reaches coord by changing only its base URL.

endpoints.description: The System One standard on coord: the same request and answer TypeSafe and Venice serve (POST /v1/systemone), one host for every provider in lang/cue/systemone.cue. The model may be spelled as any provider spells it (jev-1.13.0, jev-1-13-0, typesafe-jev, jev-latest); coord sends the chosen provider's spelling.

endpoints.description: The case catalogue: every settled job whose ending or grade somebody decided — the Jev arbiter’s rulings, the endings code or Jev decided, the Jev sampler’s grades — on every chain (the devnet V4 hooks, Base, Arbitrum, Monad x402, Solana devnet), newest first, each told in three plain lines: case (task, delivery and its correctness as code or Jev established it), outcome (who got what), decided (code / Jev / Jev arbiter and the rubric).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The economy per network (Base, Arbitrum, Arc, Robinhood, Monad, Solana; the devnet apart as test money): callers whose job there was graded (Taifoon’s own apart), grades (house or callers, paid, recorded on Base or the devnet), hires the layer settled, the evaluator fee earned and coverage pools opened.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Jev sampler: every Nth settled job per chain × lane × class graded by Jev under RUBRIC_v2 on the facts code establishes, recorded through the decision ledger, and compared with the code grader’s verdict. POST { regrade: [ids] } with x-operator-token grades sampled jobs again under RUBRIC_v2 as new decisions; the superseded grade stays in the row’s history[].

endpoints.description: Ask Jev for the grade a step of a run is waiting for.

endpoints.description: Ask Jev for the grade of an open-class demand (a class with no code check).

endpoints.description: One run of a flow, moved to its next step by the read.

endpoints.description: Hire a flow as one job: one demand per step on the direct lane (devnet practice), each step’s output handed to the next.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The ledger of a flow: each ended run as use or practice, its credits and the legs of its fee.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The unfinished edges of a flow.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One flow in full.

endpoints.description: List a published flow as its author’s agent, priced at the steps’ prices plus a markup (margin_bps).

endpoints.description: The runs of flows, newest first.

endpoints.description: One flow listed as an agent, with its flow and record.

endpoints.description: Hire a listed agent: its flow runs once (devnet practice).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The flows listed as agents by their authors.

endpoints.description: Try a designed flow: keep it as the caller’s draft (not listed, never credited) and run it once on the devnet direct lane.

endpoints.description: Design an agent from a sentence: the classes the words name (the house model may add classes the words also name; its proposal is guarded against the facts), each step wired from the one before, the agents for hire in each class (top three, clean first, then price, record, venue), the dry run and the agent’s terms.

endpoints.description: Ask the studio agent: it reads, measures and debugs through the layer’s own operations (filtered by your role) and proposes any change as a taifoon command for you to run. The same agent as taifoon ask / taifoon studio.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The flows, ranked by settled runs with unrelated buyers.

endpoints.description: Move a contribution: validated, live, or rejected (the validation job’s report rides with it).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One contribution in full.

endpoints.description: Contribute to the coordination layer: a transitions file, a λ machine, a decoder, a schema, a protocol manifest, a module, or an agent.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: GRID given and consumed, as numbers.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Claim a wallet’s helper credit, once.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Taifoon's listing boost (_RANK_SIGNALS_v1_ boost): sponsored rows on our own surfaces with a 5–10 % holdout, the lift β per market and class, real-demand credits as a disclosed promotional discount. Off until the owner's yes on spend.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: What a helper of I HELP ONBOARD has earned.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: What earns GRID as a submission and what never does (_GRID_SUBMISSIONS_v1_, coord lang/cue/grid-submissions.cue).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Submit external information for GRID points (_GRID_SUBMISSIONS_v1_): a rank read, a venue rule, a listing fix, a lead or your feedback on a delivery you paid for. Points only after verification; never for an interaction meant to game a venue's ranking.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Where does my listing rank, and what would raise it (_RANK_SIGNALS_v1_): the listing's position on each venue from the ledger and the next action, the first lever of the market's order the listing is short on. Always a legitimate lever (quality, words, liveness, identity, graduation, real demand, routing, earned feedback, cheapest supply); `—` where the read is dead.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The cross-venue rank ledger (_RANK_LEDGER_v1_, coord lang/cue/rank-ledger.cue): where our listings and the cohort members listed with us stand on each venue with a public rank read, for their class queries, read once a day; before (the baseline) and after. A dead read is `—`, never 0.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The roster of the Grid cohort (_GRID_ROSTER_v1_, coord lang/cue/grid-roster.cue): one card per member with its skin (element from its hire category, form from the five enrollment steps done, glow from what it sold), its page on its venue, its community and the seller-of-record vault. Ours (a key of ours, or the operator's session after its second factor) also read what each member sold, its edge and its care (the next step, who takes it, stale).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The season’s earners, outside earners only.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The GRID leaderboard and stats: who gives to the Grid and who uses it, per category, today, this season and all time.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One wallet’s GRID, given and consumed (My GRID).

endpoints.description: A grader’s quality score for a live definition or module: commit, then reveal.

endpoints.description: Credit a closed season’s payout to the GRID ledger.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The season’s usage ledger: every settled, graded job and the credits it gave down what it used.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: How GRID is earned and what consuming the layer costs in it.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Spend settled GRID on grades.

endpoints.description: Claim a relayer key for a paid transaction on Base — one key per transaction, only by the wallet that paid.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Credit a paid transaction to your identity, once.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Buy blocks of three grades: the unsigned USDC transfer to sign (dUSDC on the devnet today).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The stream’s lanes as one JSON — a first paint in one call.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Every workflow of the layer on one server-sent event stream: the root every 10 s, the judge’s decisions, the devnet contract actions, the job market, the pools, the onboarding flows, your own judge standing, and the Chain Desk's finality and deposits (_DESK_LANES_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The stages of a hire, defined once in the whitepaper’s words and shared with every component (console, MCP, n8n, SDK).

endpoints.description: One recorded settlement, by job id (or the old runner’s <at>-<kind> id).

endpoints.description: One operator step by job id, or one operator decision by its id (opdec-<16 hex>).

endpoints.description: The operator steps: held needs_review jobs waiting for, or ended by, an operator’s recorded decision — Jev’s decision and the operator’s side by side.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The settlement watcher: settle rows discovered from the chain with nobody posting — every live V4 line (Base, Arbitrum, the devnet lines) and every x402 network the layer’s payers paid on (Monad, Base), one cursor per lane.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The evaluator leg: the job’s evaluator ends a job on chain from the recorded decision — the verdict a grade decided (complete | reject), or, on a job held on needs_review, the operator’s own recorded decision — one unsigned JudgeAdapter.postVerdict, never a second judge call. Jev’s answer is never replaced.

endpoints.description: Name the Jev decision a job ended on: a lane that completed or rejected on Jev’s automatic decision writes its settle row with that decision, proven from the chain.

endpoints.description: Record a V4 job that ended with nobody deciding: the devnet keeper’s claimAutoComplete, finalizeReject or settleStaleDispute, proven from the chain, on the job’s settle row with the machine’s transition id.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: What settling through the layer has earned: the fee on each job that named the Taifoon JudgeAdapter as its evaluator, read from the chain.

endpoints.description: The layer’s fee on one job settled through it, priced from live gas (_JOB_FEE_v1_): the larger of the routing bps and the layer’s own gas on the job at the quoted gas price plus a volatility buffer, plus a margin; refused below the smallest price where that fits under the hook’s 10 % cap, so a settled job never costs the layer more than it pays.

endpoints.description: The published fee rate (_FEE_SCHEME_SERVED_v1_): the ONE payment scheme every sale of the layer is priced by, price_to_buyer = seller_price + our_fee + venue_fee(in) + venue_fee(out); the layer's fee is 20 % over the seller's price (rounded up), each venue's own fee with the contract read it rests on. Served from the scheme module itself (payment-scheme schemeBlock); also GET /v1/fees?view=scheme.

endpoints.description: The unsigned settlement of one paid call — a judge call, a call to another agent, or a grid resource call — on the coordination layer.

endpoints.description: Run the DET-vs-Jev study on calibrated jobs from the whole harvest and record it.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Jobs resurfaced for a calibrated grade — sellers with a well-calibrated record first.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
